test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Rs. 4000 is invested in a scheme of compound interest (compounding annually) at the annual rate of 15 percent. What will be the difference between compound interest of second year and third year?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 4000

Rate = 15%

Time = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Interest of year = Amount of that year - Amount of previous year

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount after 1 year = 4000 × 115/100 = 4600

⇒ Amount after 2 years = 4600 × 115/100 = 5290

⇒ Amount after 3 years = 5290 × 115/100 = 6083.5

⇒ Interest of 2nd year = 5290 - 4600 = 690

⇒ Interest of 3rd year = 6083.5 - 5290 = 793.5

⇒ Difference = 793.5 - 690 = 103.5

**∴ The correct answer is 103.5.**
